columns.name: tenant_id
columns.description: Tenant boundary; required in every key, partition and relationship. Exposing it does not enforce authorization.

columns.name: rental_id
columns.description: Rental identifier local to a tenant.

columns.description: Location identifier local to a tenant.

columns.description: Current live location label; not the historical label at rental time.
columns.lineage: stg_locations.location_name joined on tenant_id + location_id; current label

columns.name: rental_status
columns.description: Current source status; completed is required for revenue eligibility.

columns.name: rental_date
columns.description: UTC rental date represented as a canonical VARCHAR; used for downstream reporting filters.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Currency code; USD in this fixture. Eligible charge and rental currencies must agree.

columns.name: fee_amount
columns.description: Sum of eligible rental and damage fees for this rental, decimal zero when none.
columns.lineage: sum(int_eligible_charges.signed_amount) for rental_fee/damage_fee per tenant_id + rental_id; zero if none

columns.name: refund_amount
columns.description: Sum of signed eligible refunds for this rental; negative or decimal zero.
columns.lineage: sum(int_eligible_charges.signed_amount) for refund per tenant_id + rental_id; zero if none

columns.name: net_revenue
columns.description: fee_amount + refund_amount, fixed DECIMAL(18,2); downstream revenue metric sums this field.

columns.name: eligible_charge_count
columns.description: Count of actual eligible charge IDs at rental grain, integer zero when none; deposits are excluded.
columns.lineage: count(int_eligible_charges.charge_id) per tenant_id + rental_id; zero if none
